list.title: Maintenance reports
list.subtitle: Issues reported at your stations and their approval status.
list.emptyDescription: Reports filed at your stations will appear here.
list.loadFailedUnknown: The server did not return a reason.
list.emptyFilteredDescription: The request succeeded: there are simply no matching reports in your stations.

create.title: New maintenance report
create.subtitle: Describe the problem so it can be reviewed and routed to maintenance.
create.pickBranchFirst: Choose a branch to see its assets.
create.assetsLoadFailed: Could not load the assets of this branch.
create.assetsEmpty: This branch has no assets yet.
create.locationPlaceholder: e.g. pump island 3, fuel tank room
create.attachmentsHint: Up to {{count}} files (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP or PDF, max 5 MB each).
create.fileTypeRejected: “{{name}}” is not a supported file type.
create.tooManyFiles: You can attach at most {{count}} files.
create.titleRequired: Please enter a title for the report.
create.createdWithFailedAttachments: The report was created, but these files could not be uploaded: {{names}}. Open the report and try again.
create.branchRequired: Select the station this report is about.
create.branchInactive: This station is deactivated and cannot receive new reports.

details.addFilesHint: You can add {{count}} more file(s) (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP or PDF, max 5 MB each) until the report is reviewed.
details.filesLimitReached: The limit of {{count}} files has been reached.
details.filesLocked: Files can no longer be added or changed because the report has been reviewed.

decide.title: Maintenance decision
decide.branchHint: This report has no branch. Choose the branch where the external maintenance will be carried out.

edit.title: Edit report
edit.description: You can edit your own report until someone reviews it. The station and the review history cannot be changed.
edit.noStationNoAsset: This older report has no station, so an asset cannot be chosen.
edit.changed: The report was changed by someone else. It has been reloaded.
edit.changedWhileReviewing: The report changed after you opened it. It has been reloaded — review it again.
edit.notEditable: This report was already reviewed and can no longer be edited.
edit.notAllowed: Only the person who filed the report can edit it.
edit.assetMismatch: The selected asset does not belong to this report's station.
